title: 横浜スタジアム・推しグルメで乾杯リール
scene: 横浜スタジアムのコンコースで人気の球場グルメを持って笑顔で歩く女性。観客席でグルメを頬張り、友達とビールで乾杯。夕暮れのスタンドで幸せそうな表情と球場の空気感を切り取る。
caption:
一人で観戦する日も、友達と一緒の日も…球場グルメがあるだけで、野球観戦がもっと特別な時間になる🍽️✨
横浜スタジアムの名物「ベイスターズドッグ」と冷えたビールは、やっぱり外せないよね！コンコースを歩きながら“今日はどれ食べよう？”って悩むのも楽しい。
夕暮れに染まる客席で頬張るグルメは、不思議とどれも美味しく感じるから不思議。ビールで乾杯したら、野球のある日常がもっと好きになるかも🍺
“推しグルメ”に出会えた瞬間、また来たくなる理由になる…そんな小さな幸せを、これからもたくさん集めたいな。
あなたの球場グルメの推しもぜひコメントで教えてください！気になったら保存して、次の観戦の参考にしてね♡

prompts.kling: Vertical 9:16, 10-15s, photorealistic, smartphone-shot look, natural handheld motion. Two fashionable Japanese women in their 20s, one with medium-length straight hair, the other with a soft ponytail, wearing casual pastel-toned outfits. Start with them smiling and holding popular Yokohama Stadium gourmet food and beer while walking through the stadium concourse. Capture them sitting in the stands, taking a bite of a stadium hot dog with a joyful expression, then clinking their beers together as the evening sky glows behind them. Soft pastel color grading, no text overlays, candid and authentic, no AI artifacts.
prompts.veo: vertical 9:16, 10-15s, photorealistic, smartphone-shot look, natural handheld motion, Japanese women in their 20s at Yokohama Stadium, soft pastel color grading, no text overlays, no AI artifacts. 0-5s: Two casually-dressed Japanese women walk along the stadium concourse, smiling and holding gourmet food like a stadium hot dog and beer; close-up on food in their hands. 5-10s: Sitting together in the stands, one takes a bite of the hot dog, both laugh, then raise their beers. 10-15s: Cheers with beers as the warm evening sunlight filters over the crowd, lingering on their relaxed, happy expressions and the soft colors of the stands.
